sources.coverage: Country-specific surname column collected from locatefamily.com geographic listings in 2019; archived by SajjadPourali/Surnames; no numerical ranks/frequencies imported.
sources.limitations: Secondary address-geographic dataset, not verified national census/citizenship register. Possible false surname-field values, business terms, spelling errors and given-name-as-surname cases. Clear corporate/non-name tokens filtered. Manual attestation and upstream data licensing review required before production.
